3. A completed Submission Form in PDF format which is signed by an authorized representative of the proponent described in Appendix C.

5. A completed Pricing Excel Workbook described in Appendix B – Section G. Template for workbook provided.
6. A completed Requirements Excel Workbook. Instructions are in the provided requirements workbook.

mandatory_technical_requirements.quote:
D. MANDATORY TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS
The following sets out the mandatory technical requirements of the proponent and the proposed solution:
1. Support for organizations operating in Canada including support for Canadian taxes and Canadian Payroll.
2. Vendor has experience implementing solutions for First Nations in Canada.
3. The solution must be hosted in Canada and stores all data within Canada.
4. Implementation vendor(s) can demonstrate they have at least five years' experience implementing Finance, HR, Payroll, and Asset Management solutions.
5. Solution is cloud based.
6. The solutions are SOC2 Type 2 compliant or equivalent.
Failure to meet the mandatory technical will result in disqualification from consideration.
value: Support for organizations operating in Canada including support for Canadian taxes and Canadian Payroll.
Vendor has experience implementing solutions for First Nations in Canada.
The solution must be hosted in Canada and stores all data within Canada.
Implementation vendor(s) can demonstrate they have at least five years' experience implementing Finance, HR, Payroll, and Asset Management solutions.
The solutions are SOC2 Type 2 compliant or equivalent.

vendor_demonstration_required.quote: At the conclusion of the evaluation, Cowichan Tribes will conduct a cumulative assessment and invite the top two or three vendors to provide a demonstration at their discretion. Vendors selected for the demonstration stage will be required to present their proposed solutions in accordance with the demo script that will be provided by Cowichan Tribes. The script will outline the key functionalities and scenarios that must be addressed during the demonstration. To successfully pass this stage, vendors must demonstrate how their solution meets the specified requirements and effectively addresses the use cases outlined in the script. Failure to follow the script or demonstrate the required capabilities may impact the evaluation and progression to the next stage.
